title: From biomass to bioactivity: Butea monosperma bark-derived carbon quantum dots for benzopyran synthesis and their in silico studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,28987-29011
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02823C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sunita Teli, Shivani Soni, Nisarg Rana, Anu Manhas, Shikha Agarwal
A green synthetic protocol for the synthesis of benzopyrans has been developed using biomass-derived CQDs obtained from Butea monosperma bark. A diverse library of 17 benzopyrans was synthesized in high yields within 10–35 min at RT.
